text:
sam: quick heads up — i'm going to roll the new routing.runtime.staged_safety_level config to 10% tonight. it reduces weight to latency pools for noisy tenants. want a quick console preview before i push. cc @jen @kevin :eyes:
jen: thanks — can you share the preview URL? want to eyeball quota/cost delta first.
sam: console draft: /console/configs/runtime/staged-safety-level?preview=true (link). sample payload:
```json
{
  \"key\": \"routing.runtime.staged_safety_level\",
  \"value\": 0.1,
  \"mode\": \"gradual\",
  \"buckets\": [{\"cohort\":\"canary\",\"pct\":10}]
}
```
kevin: what's the telemetry plan? we need tracing + token-level breakdown and an alert if p95 latency > 250ms for >5m.
tia: suggestion: set telemetry.sample_rate = 0.5 for the canary cohort and create a dashboard panel 'staged-safety-level / canary' with: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, quota-consumption, cost-per-token. also add metric 'config.rollout.latency.delta'.
mike: also strongly recommend a dry-run mode: evaluate routing decisions and emit metrics but don't change weights. run a synthetic load against dry-run for ~15m. checklist idea: preflight health, quota delta, cost estimate, fallback route pin.
jen: can we expose the dry-run as 'Preview + validate' in the console? product wants one-click preflight that returns a validation report (quota impact + telemetry snapshot). :thumbsup:
sam: agree. backend should accept ?dry_run=true and return a report object with diffs. example: `curl -X POST /api/configs/apply?dry_run=true -d @payload.json -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\"` — response should include sampling hints and estimated qps.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary cluster redeploy queued (job x123). ETA ~12m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: for alerts, create a temporary SLO: p95 target 200ms for canary cohort, TTL 1h. if violated, auto-pause the rollout and tag owners.
tia: +1 on auto-pause. also log trace_id -> config_version mapping so we can quickly find offending traces and rollback.
sam: plan: start 23:30 PT tonight. schedule: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. i'll post status updates in #eng-platform during the rollout and create a short postmortem if anything surprising happens. pushing preview now.
jen: thanks — i'll run the synthetic job and watch dashboards. ping if you want an immediate rollback.
mike: i'll add a small playbook snippet to the config page: steps to pause, how to pin fallback routes, and command to force-apply rollback. example rollback command:
```
# force rollback to previous config
curl -X POST /api/configs/apply -d '{"key":"routing.runtime.staged_safety_level","value":0.0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
sam: sweet. if preview looks good i'll flip canary tonight. :sparkles:
